plan: Implement a small state machine with validation-before-mutation.
Centralize prompt, screen, error, and appointment-choice construction.
Keep console I/O behind injected source and sink objects.
mechanisms: A four-key public session dictionary represents all accepted state.
Action-specific handlers enforce lifecycle and field-type preconditions.
Screens are freshly constructed with exactly the required keys.
Invalid actions restore the pre-action session snapshot and return an Error message.
run_once validates both adapters before performing either I/O call.
